topics.name: Service Boundaries
topics.description: Where the agent sits in a system.
notes: - 把 agent 作为一个有明确输入输出契约的服务，而不是散落在业务代码里的函数调用。
- 常见分层：API 网关/鉴权 → agent 服务（LangGraph）→ 工具和数据源 → 模型提供商。
- 客户端（Web/手机）只调用你的后端，模型 API Key 只保存在后端。
- 长任务使用异步执行：提交任务、返回任务 ID，再轮询或流式推送结果。
- 状态持久化到数据库（checkpointer），服务实例就可以无状态地水平扩展。

topics.name: Reliability
notes: - 超时：为每次模型和工具调用设置超时，避免请求挂起。
- 重试：对瞬时错误（429、5xx、网络错误）使用指数退避重试；对确定性错误（参数错误）不要重试。
- 幂等：会产生副作用的工具（下单、发邮件）需要幂等键，避免重试造成重复执行。
- 降级：主模型失败时切换备用模型，或返回缓存/兜底回答。
- 限流和预算：限制每个用户的调用频率，以及单次请求的最大 token 和循环次数。

questions.title: A mobile app uses an LLM through your own service. Where should the LLM provider API key live?

options.text: On the backend only; the app calls your backend
Inside the mobile app's resources
In the app's local database
In the README

questions.explanation: Anything shipped inside an app can be extracted. The backend holds secrets and enforces authentication and limits.

questions.title: Why persist agent state in a database-backed checkpointer in production?

options.text: Service instances stay stateless, so they can scale out and resume any thread
It makes the model smarter
It removes the need for authentication
It reduces token usage to zero

questions.explanation: With state outside the process, any instance can continue a conversation and restarts do not lose progress.

questions.title: An agent task can take several minutes. Which API design is most appropriate?

options.text: Submit the task, return a task ID, then poll or stream the result
Keep one HTTP request open with no timeout
Ask the client to run the agent locally
Drop the request if it takes longer than a second

questions.explanation: An asynchronous job pattern avoids client and proxy timeouts and lets users see progress.

questions.title: Which failures are good candidates for retry with exponential backoff?

options.text: HTTP 429 rate limit
HTTP 503 service unavailable
A transient network timeout
A tool call with invalid arguments

questions.explanation: Transient errors may succeed later. Deterministic errors such as invalid arguments will fail again, so fix the cause instead.

questions.title: Why do tools with side effects, such as creating an order, need idempotency keys?

options.text: So that a retry does not execute the action twice
So that the model can read the key
To speed up the model
To encrypt the order

questions.explanation: The server recognizes a repeated request with the same key and returns the earlier result instead of acting again.

questions.title: What is wrong with this retry loop?

options.text: It retries every exception immediately without backoff and silently returns None after the last failure
range cannot be used with try
return is not allowed inside try
invoke cannot be retried

questions.explanation: Wait with increasing delay, retry only transient errors, and raise the last error when attempts run out.

questions.title: What is a fallback in an LLM application?

options.text: An alternative model or a safe default answer used when the primary call fails
A second copy of the database
A longer prompt
A faster tokenizer

questions.explanation: Fallbacks keep the service useful during provider outages or errors, at the cost of possibly lower quality.
